title: CF Meet platform common definitions v1
description: Shared vocabulary for cross-service CF Meet contracts. Definitions only: the root schema places no constraints; contracts reference the $defs below.

ServiceId.description: Stable, product-independent identity of a deployable CF Meet backend service, e.g. cfmeet.calling, cfmeet.privacy-relay, cfmeet.telephony. Never a wildcard.

RuntimeEnvironment.description: Deployment/runtime environment of a service identity. Not the same dimension as a customer's application environment (SANDBOX / TEST / PRODUCTION).

RequestId.description: Server-generated identifier of one request / one service hop.

CorrelationId.description: Server-generated identifier that stays stable across every hop of one causal operation.

ApplicationEnvironmentKind.description: Kind of a customer application environment (Part B section 7).

PrincipalKind.description: Category of communication principal (Part B section 10).

KeyId.description: Identifier of a service signing key (JWS kid).

InternalPermission.description: Internal service permission, granted only by the receiving service's trust policy. The receiver and permitted issuers of each permission are fixed by the platform permission registry (packages/service-auth).
